title: Block export of ‘national treasure’ UK fossils, says MP

paragraphs.en: An MP has called on ministers to change export controls so that significant fossils can be classed as national treasures after one of the UK’s best collections, unearthed on Dorset beaches, was sold overseas.
paragraphs.zh: 一位英国议员呼吁部长们修改出口管制规定，让重要化石得以被列为国家珍宝。此前，在多塞特海滩出土的英国最优质化石收藏之一被卖到了海外。

paragraphs.en: Last week, a Guardian investigation revealed that an unparalleled collection of fossils from the UK’s Jurassic Coast, comprising hundreds of specimens including ichthyosaurs, had been sold to the Natural History Museum in Abu Dhabi for what one source described as an “eight-figure sum”.
paragraphs.zh: 上周，《卫报》的一项调查披露，一批从英国侏罗纪海岸出土、包括数百件标本（其中含鱼龙）的绝无仅有的化石收藏，被卖给了阿布扎比自然历史博物馆，一位消息人士称成交价达到“八位数”。

paragraphs.en: The fossils, which belonged to the Dorset-based private collector Chris Moore, were initially offered to the Natural History Museum (NHM) in London and Amgueddfa Cymru (Museum Wales), but neither institution had the funds to buy them.
paragraphs.zh: 这批化石原属多塞特私人收藏家克里斯·摩尔，最初曾被提供给伦敦自然历史博物馆和威尔士国家博物馆（Amgueddfa Cymru），但两家机构都没有财力将其买下。

paragraphs.en: Senior figures at Lyme Regis Museum have called on ministers to change the way fossil discoveries are recorded and sold. They said they were not informed of the impending sale of Moore’s collection or given the opportunity to acquire it.
paragraphs.zh: 莱姆里吉斯博物馆的高层人士呼吁部长们修改化石发现记录与销售的方式。他们说，他们并未被告知摩尔这批收藏即将出售的消息，也没有获得收购的机会。

paragraphs.en: A letter from Bridget Houseago, the director of the museum, to Edward Morello, the Liberal Democrat MP for West Dorset, notes that the UK’s cultural goods export controls – intended to give the country an opportunity to retain objects of outstanding national importance – do not cover fossils and other items of natural history because they are not “made”.
paragraphs.zh: 该博物馆馆长布里奇特·豪萨戈致函西多塞特自由民主党议员爱德华·莫雷洛，指出英国的文化物品出口管制——旨在给国家一个机会留存具有突出国家意义的物品——并不涵盖化石及其他自然历史物品，因为它们并非“制造”出来的。

paragraphs.en: This means that “some important and rare fossils can be sold without an export licence,” the letter states.
paragraphs.zh: 信中指出，这意味着“一些重要且罕见的化石可以在没有出口许可证的情况下被出售”。

paragraphs.en: Lyme Regis Museum was aware of Moore’s collection and considered it among the best private collections from the Lower Lias of Dorset, containing several unique specimens.
paragraphs.zh: 莱姆里吉斯博物馆了解摩尔的收藏，并认为它属于多塞特下里亚斯地层最佳私人收藏之列，其中包含若干独特标本。

paragraphs.en: Although the museum understood indirectly that Moore might eventually want to sell some or all of the collection, or have it placed on public display, it was unaware that a sale of the collection was under way at the end of 2025.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管博物馆间接得知，摩尔最终可能会出售部分或全部收藏，或将其公开展出，但它并不知道在2025年底这批收藏的出售已在推进之中。
